title: Air India Launches Great Escape Sale With International Fares From $350
excerpt: Bookings close October 3 for the limited-period sale, which covers Air India and Air India Express flights to 40-plus destinations with travel valid through March 2027 for North American travelers.
body:
• Air India's Great Escape Sale runs through 11:59 p.m. on October 3, 2026, for bookings made on its website, app, contact center or through authorized agents.
  • US one-way international fares start at $350 and round-trips at $650; from Canada, fares start at C$449 one-way and C$899 round-trip.
  • Travel is valid through March 31, 2027 for departures from the US, Canada and Australia — covering the festive and year-end holiday season.
  • The sale covers 40+ destinations on Air India and Air India Express, with up to 50% off convenience fees for logged-in members.

Sale ends Saturday; fares cover 40-plus destinations

Air India has launched its "Great Escape Sale," offering discounted international-to-international fares for travelers in the US and Canada connecting across the airline's global network. The limited-period sale is open for bookings through October 3, 2026, with discounted fares valid for travel through March 31, 2027, subject to blackout dates and seat availability.

The sale applies to flights operated by both Air India and Air India Express, and both one-way and round-trip bookings are eligible. One-way fares from the US start at $350, while fares from Canada start at C$449 on select international routes; round-trip fares start at $650 from the US and C$899 from Canada, according to The American Bazaar. Seats are limited and fares are subject to availability at the time of booking.

Context & Background

Air India announced the sale on September 28 for travelers in the United States and Canada, though its official sale page extends the offer to departures from the UK, Europe, Southeast Asia, South Asia, the Gulf and the Far East, with travel periods running through June 30, 2027 for those origins. The carrier is pitching the sale across the Gulf, South Asia, Southeast Asia and the Far East, promising convenient schedules and short layovers across its network.

"From a quick getaway to the Gulf and holidays across South Asia to exploring Southeast Asia or discovering the Far East, travellers can make the most of attractive fares to experience more of Air India's international network," the airline said.

Logged-in members booking directly through Air India's website or mobile app can receive up to 50% off the applicable convenience fee, where one is charged. The sale is available on all channels: the airline's website, mobile app, contact center and authorized travel agents.

"From a quick getaway to the Gulf and holidays across South Asia to exploring Southeast Asia or discovering the Far East, travellers can make the most of attractive fares."

— Air India

Impact & Analysis

The fine print matters. All fares under the offer are all-inclusive — base fare plus taxes, fees and surcharges — but tickets are non-transferable and non-reroutable, name changes are not permitted, and group bookings are not eligible. The travel window through March 31, 2027 applies to US, Canada and Australia departures, with blackout dates during peak periods likely.

At $350 one-way from the US, the sale fares undercut typical off-peak economy pricing on transpacific and transatlantic itineraries, making it worth comparing against aggregator fares for the same dates. As always with fare sales, the headline minimum applies to select routes — popular corridors such as New York–Delhi or Toronto–Mumbai will price higher, but the blanket eligibility across Air India's network is broader than most airline promotions.

Diaspora Angle

The timing is tailor-made for non-resident Indians in the US and Canada planning festive-season and year-end visits to India, when demand — and fares — typically surge. The March 2027 travel window also covers spring break and early summer trips, and the sale's coverage of routes beyond India makes it easy to add a stopover in the Gulf or Southeast Asia.

What's Next

Bookings close at 11:59 p.m. on October 3, 2026 — barely a day away — so travelers need to lock in dates quickly. After the sale, Air India's next fare window will likely be the standard early-year promotions; for now, NRIs with fixed holiday plans should check the airline's fare grid directly and book before the deadline.
